title: View off with Create & Edit on is prevented by the tick-cascade
custom_preconds: 1. You are editing a custom role with the Schedule card visible.
custom_steps:
1. Tick Create & Edit on the Schedule card.
  2. See whether View ticks.
  3. Try to untick View while Create & Edit is still ticked.
custom_expected:
Ticking Create & Edit also ticks View.

Unticking View also unticks Create & Edit and Delete.

View off with Create & Edit on cannot be saved.
evidence: UI/editor: View-off + Create&Edit-on cannot be saved — the tick-cascade (verified C26360/C26362/C26363) auto-ticks View when Create&Edit is ticked, and unticks Create&Edit+Delete when View is unticked, so that invalid combination is impossible in the editor.
